source_caption:
🎬 Heart of the Beast (2026)

Heart of the Beast follows James Belmont, a former Special Forces soldier whose life takes a terrifying turn when a devastating plane crash leaves him stranded deep in the unforgiving Alaskan wilderness alongside his loyal combat dog, Odin. Far from civilization and surrounded by dangerous terrain, freezing temperatures, and unpredictable wildlife, James must rely on his military training, survival instincts, and determination to find a way back to safety. With limited resources and little hope of immediate rescue, every decision becomes a matter of life and death. As the two companions struggle through harsh weather conditions, exhausting journeys, and constant threats from the wilderness, their extraordinary bond becomes their greatest source of strength. However, the physical dangers are only part of James’s struggle, as memories of his military past and emotional wounds force him to confront painful experiences he has spent years trying to escape. Through moments of desperation, courage, sacrifice, and unwavering loyalty, James discovers that survival requires more than physical strength. Odin’s companionship provides comfort, protection, and a powerful reason to keep fighting even when the odds seem impossible. Featuring Brad Pitt in a gripping survival adventure, Heart of the Beast combines breathtaking wilderness landscapes, intense action, emotional storytelling, and a moving exploration of the relationship between humans and animals. The film celebrates resilience, friendship, trust, courage, healing, and the unbreakable connection between a man and his most faithful companion.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 41m • PG-13

🎥 Director: David Ayer

✍️ Writer: Cameron Alexander

📅 Release Date: September 25, 2026

📺 Where to Watch: In theaters and available for digital rental through Fandango at Home in the United States. Additional digital availability may vary by region.

source_details.synopsis: Heart of the Beast is a 2026 American survival thriller film directed by David Ayer and written by Cameron Alexander. The film stars Brad Pitt as a retired Special Forces veteran navigating a grueling 58-mile (93-kilometer) trek to safety with his traumatized combat German Shepherd after their seaplane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness. Heart of the Beast premiered at the FirstBank Amphitheater in Franklin, Tennessee on September 16, 2026, and released nationwide in the United States on September 25, 2026, by Paramount Pictures. The film received generally positive reviews from critics and grossed $182.2 million worldwide.
